title: Proof of existence of the categorical neutron
html:
Proof. Proof of existence of the categorical neutron

Proof. The proof parallels that for the existence of the categorical proton. We employ the crossing partition (\mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{d}, \mathfrak{d}). The Borromean braid and typed crossings define an element of H_3(q). LP-dual feasibility selects two Hopf-link gluons (L_+ \to L_-) as the minimal stabiliser. Gröbner--Shirshov reduction yields a canonical normal form satisfying G x[\gamma] \ge 0 at every intermediate step.
